propositions: markdown_to_adf must emit structurally rich ADF nodes (headings, lists, code, inline marks) from Markdown source, not literal characters
adf_to_markdown must decode ADF to Markdown and eliminate the combined strong+strikethrough 2-cycle oscillation via mark-order canonicalization
HTML comments present in source must survive round-trip by self-verification in markdown_to_adf, falling back to plain encode if marklas drops them
marklas and mistune must be lazy-imported inside function bodies with ImportError routed to plain adf.py fallback, preserving the stdlib-only engine contract
fit_markdown_to_adf_limit must measure the serialized markdown_to_adf document, not the plain text
Over a committed fixture, md→adf→md round-trip must reach fixed point in ≥99.6% of bodies and ≥20% of bodies must encode to structurally rich ADF
